title: Twin-Court Canon of the Doubled Fate
summary: A canon of the twin court on holding two fates at once, taking the kinder and passing the harsher, and ending in a doom cast twice over.

title: Hawk-Eye Treatise of the Foreseen Stroke
summary: A treatise on the hawk's eye that sees a stroke before it is thrown, ending in a decreed blow that falls where the foe is certain to be.

title: River-Run Book of the Long Skein
summary: A book of the long skein of fate wound off the spindle of the hour like a river, mending in its shallows and sundering in its flood.

title: Oath-Book of the Fate Sworn True
summary: An oath-book of the fate that is sworn and kept, ending in a decree that holds the field to the oath.

title: Plateau Canon of the Severing Shears
summary: A canon of the shears that cut the threads between a deed and its end and in the last stroke cut a foe from their fortune.

title: Treatise on the Bearing of the Last Lot
summary: A treatise on the bearing taken on the last lot to be drawn in a fight and on the stroke that is cast with it.
